fr_value.rpt_quarter AND pc_report_submission.approval_status_code = 'APPROVED' AND pc_report_submission.src_stm_code = 'IDS_COMPANY_DATA' INNER JOIN financial_report ON financial_report.fr_id = pc_report_submission.fr_id AND financial_report.news_tp_code = 'DINH_KY' AND financial_report.src_stm_code = 'IDS_FORMS' AND ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pc_report_submission.pc_code, pc_report_submission.rpt_year, pc_report_submission.rpt_quarter ORDER BY CASE WHEN financial_report.fr_code LIKE 'HN%' THEN 1 WHEN financial_report.fr_code LIKE 'TH%' THEN 2 WHEN fr_value.fr_catalog_id AND fr_catalog.fr_year = fr_value.rpt_year AND fr_catalog.financial_statement_component_tp_code = SUBSTR(financial_report.fr_code, 1, 2) AND fr_catalog.src_stm_code = 'IDS_REPORT_CATALOG' INNER JOIN fr_row ON fr_row.row_code = fr_value.row_code AND fr_row.fr_catalog_id = fr_value.fr_catalog_id AND fr_row.src_stm_code = 'IDS_RROW' AND fr_catalog.fr_catalog_code LIKE 'BCDKT%' AND ((UPPER(fr_catalog.enterprise_tp_code) IN ('DN','BH') AND fr_row.row_description_reference = '270') OR (UPPER(fr_catalog.enterprise_tp_code) = 'TD' AND fr_row.row_description_reference = '300')) INNER JOIN fr_column ON fr_column.column_code = fr_value.column_code AND fr_column.fr_catalog_id = fr_value.fr_catalog_id AND fr_column.column_description_reference = '1' AND fr_column.src_stm_code = 'IDS_RCOL' → SUM(fr_value.cell_val) WHERE ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fr_value.pc_id, fr_value.rpt_year, fr_value.rpt_quarter, fr_value.fr_catalog_id, fr_value.row_code, fr_value.column_code ORDER BY fr_value.fr_val_code DESC) = 1 GROUP BY fr_value.pc_id, fr_value.rpt_year, fr_value.rpt_quarter
